title: Sequential Stability of the Value Function and the Solution Mapping in Berge's Maximum Theorem via Variational Convergence
summary: Berge's maximum theorem ensures the continuity of the value function and the upper semicontinuity of the solution mapping in parametric optimization problems. This theorem plays a central role in optimization theory, game theory, and dynamic programming. Motivated by the inherent inaccuracies in optimization data, this paper investigates the stability of such problems under sequential perturbations of both the objective function and the feasible mapping. The analysis focuses on the convergence of sequences of value functions and solution mappings via variational approximations of the data.…
